column3: “Is about to come” is rendered “has come.”
“A great woman” is rendered “a prominent woman,” and “urged” as “persuaded.”
“Taken care to us with all this care” is rendered “been careful for us with all this care.”
“About the time living” is rendered “next year.”
“About the time living” is rendered “the next year.”
NASB renders “a donkey” and supplies “the pace.”
“Her soul is bitter” is rendered “her soul is troubled.”
“The life of your soul” is rendered “as you yourself live”; the oath form becomes “I will not leave you.”
